description: Canonical Platform engineering tool authority. Routers, schemas and validators must derive from this file.

cursor-cli.notes: Primary bounded implementation writer. One writer per checkout/worktree. Cannot self-certify. Requires no writerElevation.

cursor-cloud.notes: Never-writer under current policy. Elevation cannot authorize Cursor Cloud.

antigravity.notes: Read-only/adversarial independent exact-SHA auditor, negative/failure/security challenger and certification-gate evidence provider. Antigravity is not the sole auditor: any suitable authorized tool may perform read-only/advisory review of another tool's candidate. mayCertify=false means Antigravity supplies independent certification-gate evidence/recommendation; ChatGPT + GitHub performs final technical certification. Generated adapters must not gain write tools. Antigravity is not an implementation writer and cannot validate its own changes.

codex.notes: Founder-reactivated 2026-10-07 as an approved bounded implementation, test and debugging writer. Codex CLI and Codex Desktop (ChatGPT Desktop App Codex mode) are one Codex authority family — client interfaces to this single authority, not independent writers or independent certification sources from each other. Plain ChatGPT Desktop conversation has no assumed repository filesystem/execution access. Codex cannot independently verify, act as gatekeeper, merge or self-certify, and cannot certify its own candidate. Read-only canonical agents remain read-only; write agents default to workspace-write without implied network or unrestricted host access.

github-copilot.notes: Never-writer. Limited auxiliary PR/code-review only. Elevation cannot authorize GitHub Copilot as writer, verifier, gatekeeper, merge authority, or sole certification evidence.

rules: default writerTool is cursor-cli and requires no writerElevation
codex is an authorized non-default bounded writer and requires no writerElevation
exceptionalWriterTools is empty under the current active workflow; Antigravity cannot be elevated into a writer
neverWriterTools (cursor-cloud, github-copilot, chatgpt-github, founder) cannot become writers via elevation
one writer may own a checkout/worktree; Cursor CLI and Codex may be bounded writers in isolated worktrees concurrently only on non-overlapping lanes
a writer cannot independently certify its own candidate
verifierTool must be distinct from writerTool
gatekeeper must be distinct from writerTool
any suitable authorized tool may perform read-only/advisory review of another tool's candidate; Antigravity is an independent adversarial reviewer, not the sole auditor
Codex cannot self-certify, independently verify, act as gatekeeper or merge
generated Antigravity adapters remain read-only and Antigravity cannot write or validate its own changes
Codex CLI and Codex Desktop are one Codex authority family, not separate authorities or independent certification sources
generated Codex read agents use sandbox_mode=read-only and write agents use sandbox_mode=workspace-write; never generate danger-full-access or imply network access
dot is not a Platform writer, verifier, gatekeeper, merge or certification authority; any later Codex orchestration requires a separately frozen environment, branch, SHA, permissions and scope
github-copilot is never writer, verifier, gatekeeper, merge authority, or sole certification evidence
cursor-cloud is prohibited as writerTool; elevation cannot authorize it under current policy
final technical gate/certification authority remains ChatGPT + GitHub (Antigravity mayCertify=false supplies gate evidence only)
